main_text.p: que ingenii ferant modo vires mei, etiam ut supra vires audeam, excitabit animúmque addet, si conatus hic Vestræ Generositati arridet uni, nihil Zoilos aut Momos (quibus nemo unquam facere potuit satis) latrantes aut frementes morabor. Sic Te Deus Ter-Optimus Maximus Regi, cui propter summas ingenii dotes merito charus, Patriæ, cui Tu auspicatissimè natus, Reipublicæ, cui dexteritate animi, rerum cata celeritate singularique experientia gerendarum dileCtissimus, literis deniq; & literatis omnibus, quibus Tu unus in-star omnium Mecœnas unicè faves & foves, quam diutissimè sospitet. Vale & diu feliciter vive præsidium & dulce decus meum. Heidelberga 1614.
Illustri Generositati Tuæ devotissimus, debitissimus ANDREAS AIDIUS.

page.notes: Page has a running head "DEDICATORIA." and no page number. Some letters are damaged or faint in the scan (e.g. "cata" may read "catâ"). Signature line at the bottom is set in italic and small capitals; the closing "AIDIUS" is followed by a dagger-like mark that was read as §.
